title: SKU sellable unit of measure
description: One unit a SKU can be sold in, taken from the SKU's ACTIVE trade item of that packaging level. A BOX trade item gives { uom_code: "hộp", units_per_box } (units_per_box inner packs in one box); a CARTON trade item gives { uom_code: "thùng", boxes_per_carton } (boxes_per_carton boxes in one carton). Exactly two uom_code values exist in this contract; the inner pack (gói), jar (lọ) and pot (hũ) are never sellable units here. The entry says the unit is configured and active in ops-core, nothing about stock: whether a quantity may be committed is still decided by POST /v1/availability/check.
$comment: Source: ops-core plan row SKU-M12-03 agreed with the business-platform (M3-4, 13/11/2026). uom_code values are the ref_uom codes of ops-core, compared byte for byte in Unicode NFC: "hộp" is U+0068 U+1ED9 U+0070 (3 code points) and "thùng" is U+0074 U+0068 U+00F9 U+006E U+0067 (5 code points); a decomposed (NFD) spelling is a different string and is not accepted.

uom_code.description: Unit code, NFC, case-sensitive: "hộp" (box) or "thùng" (carton). The same codes are the unit of POST /v1/availability/check and of the stock quantities.

units_per_box.description: Present only when uom_code is "hộp": number of inner packs (gói) in one box, from the BOX trade item.

boxes_per_carton.description: Present only when uom_code is "thùng": number of boxes in one carton, from the CARTON trade item.
